_lore: Canon (Ollivander): the most consistent magic, least subject to fluctuation; the most faithful, strongly attached to its first owner; hardest to turn to the Dark Arts; not the most powerful. Gameplay: steadier and a little weaker; won in one defeat like any wand (Draco's unicorn-hair wand, Deathly Hallows ch. 24) but it serves its winner reluctantly at first, and its bond suffers every Dark cast.
